title: Laurie Lifting Baby Patrick, Suburban Yard - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor square snapshot stamped 'DEC • 67' on the top white margin. A smiling girl wearing glasses, a sleeveless shirt, and shorts gleefully lifts up a baby identified on the back as Patrick. They stand in a sunny suburban yard with a mid-century house, trees, and a parked truck or camper in the background, evoking the quintessential atmosphere of domestic American life in the late 1960s.
